option_relations.rationale: Bronchiolitis obliterans is a distinct disease of the small airways, not directly related to Chronic Tuberculosis.
Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) is a separate condition from Chronic Tuberculosis, although both can affect the lungs. The provided leaf is Chronic Tuberculosis, not COPD.
Bronchiectasis is a distinct lung condition characterized by permanent enlargement of parts of the airways, not directly equivalent to or a subtype of Chronic Tuberculosis.
Diffuse panbronchiolitis (DPB) is a specific inflammatory disease of the bronchioles, not directly related to Chronic Tuberculosis.
